units.source_text: 不料这疙瘩竟扎下了根，以灼热的沉重的力量，从我的脖颈后面压迫着我，害得我经常不能安眠。

en.t: Unexpectedly, the lump took root and pressed on me from the back of my neck with a burning, heavy force, often keeping me from sleeping peacefully.

units.source_text: 这期间，我梦见了我脖颈上长了个纯金的光圈，椭圆形的光绕着我的后脑勺，并且愈发熠熠生辉。

en.t: During that time, I dreamed that a halo of pure gold had grown around my neck, an oval light encircling the back of my head and shining ever more brilliantly.

units.source_text: 我一觉醒来，却原来不过是这充满恶意的肿物的隐痛。

en.t: When I woke, it turned out to be nothing more than the dull ache of that malicious swelling.
